choice.basis: The dashboard title explicitly states 'Increasing Regional Air Quality Recovery from 2018 to 2023', which is the primary summary of the overall trend for the planning case. While the visual data shows a fluctuating line that ends lower than the 2018 peak, the title provides the authoritative characterization of the trend as 'increasing recovery'. In the context of the provided routing options, an 'increasing recovery' trend is most logically mapped to a positive follow-up pathway, such as 'recovery expansion', rather than 'deterioration' or routine 'monitoring' of a decline. The visual conflict (line ending lower than start) is resolved in favor of the explicit textual summary provided in the chart title.
choice.option_label: Route the record to air-quality recovery expansion follow-up
